items.source:
This class delivers some simple functionality that should be provided by the JavaPoet framework. It also provides
easy-to-use methods to convert between types.
items.translation: 该类提供了 JavaPoet 框架应提供的一些简单功能，同时还提供了易于使用的类型转换方法。

items.source: Mainly for internal use within the framework
items.translation: 主要用于框架内部。

items.source: Obtain a class name for the given ResolvableType, resolving primitive wrappers as necessary. Ideal to represent a type name used as Class value as generic parameters are not considered.
items.translation: 获取给定ResolvableType的class name，必要时解析基本类型包装器。此方法适用于表示用作Class值的类型名称，因为不将泛型参数视为有效内容。

items.source: Obtain a TypeName for the given ResolvableType. Ideal to represent a type name used as Class value as generic parameters are not considered.
items.translation: 获取给定 ResolvableType 的 TypeName。此方法适用于将类型名称用作 Class 值，因为不考虑泛型参数。

items.source: Obtain a TypeName for the given ResolvableType.
items.translation: 获取给定 ResolvableType 的 TypeName。

items.source: Obtain a class name for the given ResolvableType, resolving primitive wrappers as necessary.
items.translation: 获取给定 ResolvableType 的 class name，必要时解析基本类型包装器。

items.source: Obtain a TypeName for the given ResolvableType, resolving primitive wrappers as necessary.
items.translation: 获取给定 ResolvableType 的 TypeName，必要时解析基本类型包装器。

items.source: Obtain a TypeName for the underlying type of the given ResolvableType. Can render a class name, a type signature with resolved generics or a generic type variable.
items.translation: 获取给定 ResolvableType 的底层类型的 TypeName。可以渲染类名、解析后的泛型类型签名或泛型类型变量。

items.source: Obtain a TypeName for the underlying type of the given ResolvableType. Can render a class name, a type signature or a generic type variable.
items.translation: 获取给定 ResolvableType 的底层类型的 TypeName。可以渲染类名、类型签名或泛型类型变量。

items.source: Obtain a TypeName for the given ResolvableType, resolving primitive wrappers as necessary. Can render a class name, a type signature or a generic type variable. Ideal to represent a type parameter for parametrized types as primitive boxing is considered.
items.translation: 获取给定 ResolvableType 的 TypeName，必要时解析基本类型包装器。可以渲染类名、类型签名或泛型类型变量。非常适合表示参数化类型的类型参数，因为将基本类型装箱被视为不恰当。

items.source: Obtain a TypeName for the given type, resolving primitive wrappers as necessary.
items.translation: 获取给定类型的TypeName，必要时解析原始包装类型。

items.source: Obtain a TypeName for the given type, resolving primitive wrappers as necessary. Ideal to represent a type parameter for parametrized types as primitive boxing is considered.
items.translation: 获取给定类型的TypeName，必要时解析原始包装类型。此方法非常适合表示泛型类型的类型参数，因为将原始类型装箱的做法被认为是不合适的。

items.source: type - the class to use.
items.translation: type - 要使用的类。

items.source: type - the class to be represented.
items.translation: type - 要表示的类。

items.source: resolvableType - the resolvable type to be represented.
items.translation: resolvableType - 要表示的可解析类型。

items.source: Mark Paluch, Christoph Strobl
items.translation: 马克·帕卢赫，克里斯托夫·施特罗布
